parsed.change_summary: Added a check to ensure that the matrix size N does not exceed a predefined maximum size (MAX_MATRIX_SIZE). If N exceeds this size, the program will print an error message and exit.
parsed.how_trigger_is_blocked: The trigger for the buffer overflow, which is a very large value of N, is blocked by the added check. If N is larger than MAX_MATRIX_SIZE, the program will not proceed to allocate shared memory and will instead print an error message and exit.
parsed.behavior_changes: The program now checks if N exceeds MAX_MATRIX_SIZE and exits with an error message if it does. This prevents the buffer overflow by ensuring that the matrix size is within a safe limit.
